name: cobrew
description: Workflow skills and shared instructions for coding agents.

interface.longDescription: CoBrew provides structured workflows for asking clarifying questions, fixing bugs, reviewing changes, brainstorming, writing plans, executing plans, maintaining docs, creating commits, quick implementation, and source-adjacent visualizations.
defaultPrompt: $brainstorm I want to implement a new feature but I'm not sure where to start.
$write-plan Make the feature A same pattern with B
$quick-implement Edit README.md to add instructions for the new feature
